# Image titles are empty, if image legend is empty - FO

HTML image TITLE is empty, if image legend is empty.

## Attendu
HTML image TITLE should not be empty, if image legend is empty.
It should be filled with product name.

## Étapes
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to product listing (for example) and view page source.
2. Check the product image with empty image legend.
3. You can see, that only ALT attribute is filled.
4. If you check product image with legend instead - you can see that both  ALT and TITLE attributes are filled
